items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I was playing with Willie Coney's band at the time. I was playing clarinet down there.

ctx.x: Yeah. I bought that War Lions and I was playing with Willie Coney's band at the time. I was playing clarinet down there.
Excuse me, who were some of the other early saxes before you?
